page.about.title: About GrowMedica.cz
page.about.intro: We are a team that believes in natural biomedical supplements backed by real science and a growing community in Central Europe.
page.about.missionBody: At GrowMedica.cz our priority is bringing natural biomedical supplements that truly help. We do not just make more supplements — we create functional, clean and highly absorbable products for customers in Central Europe.
page.about.qualityBody: We select only the purest ingredients from verified sources to ensure maximum effectiveness.
page.about.scienceBody: Every product is carefully formulated based on current scientific knowledge and research.
page.about.transparencyBody: No hidden ingredients, no unnecessary fillers — only pure actives your body can use.
page.about.quote: “Health is not a given — it is a lifelong investment. At GrowMedica.cz we put the best tools in your hands so that investment can succeed.”

page.terms.s4p: We deliver goods to the address or pickup point specified by the buyer. Further shipping terms are on the Shipping and payment page.
page.terms.s5p: A consumer may withdraw from the contract without giving a reason within 14 days of receiving the goods. Details are set out in the Returns policy.
page.returns.processP: If you are not satisfied with the goods or they were damaged in transit, contact us at {email}. Include the order number, a description of the defect and photos if possible.
page.returns.contactBefore: Please contact us by email before sending goods back for confirmation and instructions.
